# JPR Electrical Contractors Pty Ltd — Full context

## Who we are

JPR Electrical Contractors Pty Ltd is a Gold Coast based electrical contractor (QLD Lic 91131, ABN 98 698 175 316). Mechanical services electrical is the lead offer: HVAC power and controls for mechanical contractors, builders and project managers from Brisbane through the Gold Coast to Byron Bay.

Typical mechanical electrical scope includes AC, FCU and CU power, MSSBs, VSDs, isolators, DDC/BMS interfaces, chillers, pumps, fans, exhaust systems, plant room containment, testing and commissioning. Commercial fitouts, civil/URD reticulation, high-end residential and solar/battery remain secondary divisions.

**Disambiguation:** Not affiliated with JPR Electrical (Brisbane) or J&P Richardson Industries.

## Services

1. Mechanical Services Electrical — AC/FCU/CU power, controls, MSSBs, VSDs, isolators, DDC/BMS interfaces, plant rooms, testing and commissioning
2. Commercial & Industrial — retail, hospitality, office fitouts, base-build, switchboards
3. Civil, Underground & Infrastructure — subdivision reticulation, street lighting, pit & pipe
4. High-End Residential — custom homes, architectural lighting, automation, EV charging
5. Solar & Battery — Tier-1 solar, Tesla Powerwall, Sungrow storage
